card.name: Linking word before serious adverse event
card.fires_on: The small linking word ("of" or "to") right after a noun like "cases", "precursors" or "diarrhea", just before a severe outcome is named. It appears in adverse-reaction warnings.

modes.label: Rare cases of
modes.description: "of" after "rare (sometimes fatal) cases", before a serious injury or event.
modes.example: In addition, rare, sometimes fatal, cases<< of>> severe hepatic injury, including fulmin

modes.label: Range or precursor to
modes.description: "to" after "precursors" or after a mild finding in a range, before a worse outcome.
modes.example: such symptoms may represent precursors<< to>> emerging suicidality.

card.plain: It fires on the little word that leads into a serious side effect, as in "rare cases of" or "from mild diarrhea to".
